test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following won the Padma award for the year 2023 for his efforts on S &T based innovative ways of creating Naga folk music?
solution:
The correct answer is Moa Subong.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Moa Subong:-**

 
 
• He is a 57-year-old musician from Nagaland, invented Bamhum what he considers the “easiest musical instrument in the world”.
 
• Moa earned the National Award for Grassroot Innovation in March 2017 from former President, Pranab Mukherjee for Bumhum.
 
• **He won the Padma award for the year 2023 for his efforts on S &T based innovative ways of creating Naga folk music.**
